description: This header file declares functions related to manipulating HTTP request headers in the WebKit WebKitBrowser component within the WPEFramework. It contains function declarations for setting, removing, and applying request headers.

methods.name: SetRequestHeaders
methods.description: Sets request headers for a WKBundlePageRef using a WKTypeRef.

methods.name: RemoveRequestHeaders
methods.description: Removes request headers associated with a WKBundlePageRef.

methods.name: ApplyRequestHeaders
methods.description: Applies request headers to a WKURLRequestRef within the context of a WKBundlePageRef.
